events.title: 도쿄 고지마치에서 태어나다
events.description: 도쿄 고지마치에서 육군 중장 도조 히데노리의 셋째 아들로 태어났다.
events.description_en: He was born in the Kōjimachi district of Tokyo, the third son of Army Lieutenant General Tojo Hidenori.

events.title: 육군사관학교와 육군대학을 마치다
events.title_en: He graduated from the Army Academy and the Army War College
events.description: 육군사관학교를 거쳐 육군대학을 졸업하며 정통 군인의 길을 밟았다.
events.description_en: He passed through the Army Academy and graduated from the Army War College, following the standard career of a professional soldier.

events.title: 관동군 참모장이 되다
events.title_en: He became chief of staff of the Kwantung Army
events.description_en: He became chief of staff of the Kwantung Army, stationed in Manchuria.

events.title: 육군대신이 되다
events.description: 일본 정부의 육군대신으로 임명되어 군의 정책을 이끌었다.
events.description_en: He was appointed Minister of War in the Japanese government and steered military policy.

events.title: 고노에를 밀어내고 총리에 오르다
events.title_en: He forced out Konoe and became Prime Minister
events.description: 고노에 후미마로를 밀어내고 총리 자리를 차지했다. 육군대신과 내무대신도 함께 겸했다.
events.description_en: He forced Fumimaro Konoe out and took the office of prime minister, holding the war and home ministries at the same time.

events.title: 진주만 공격을 결정하다
events.title_en: He decided on the attack on Pearl Harbor
events.description: 총리로서 진주만 기습을 재가했다. 이 공격으로 미국이 태평양전쟁에 뛰어들었다.
events.description_en: As prime minister he authorized the surprise attack on Pearl Harbor. The strike drew the United States into the Pacific War.

events.title: 참모총장까지 겸해 권력을 집중하다
events.title_en: He also took the post of Army Chief of Staff, concentrating power
events.description: 전세가 기울자 참모총장 자리까지 겸해 군과 정부의 권력을 한 손에 모았다.
events.description_en: As the war turned against Japan, he took on the post of Army Chief of Staff as well, gathering military and government power into his own hands.

events.title: 사이판 함락 뒤 총리에서 물러나다
events.title_en: He resigned as Prime Minister after the fall of Saipan
events.description: 사이판이 미군에게 함락되며 내각에 대한 책임론이 커지자 내각 전체와 함께 총리직에서 물러났다.
events.description_en: As Saipan fell to American forces and pressure over his cabinet's failures mounted, he resigned as prime minister along with his entire cabinet.

events.title: 항복 후 권총으로 자결을 시도하다
events.title_en: He attempted suicide by gunshot after the surrender
events.description: 일본이 항복한 뒤 미군에게 체포되기 직전 권총으로 스스로 목숨을 끊으려 했다. 총알이 심장을 빗나가 목숨을 건졌다.
events.description_en: After Japan's surrender, just before American forces could arrest him, he shot himself in an attempt to end his life. The bullet missed his heart, and he survived.

events.title: 극동국제군사재판에 A급 전범으로 기소되다
events.title_en: He was indicted as a Class A war criminal before the Tokyo tribunal
events.description: 극동국제군사재판에서 A급 전범으로 기소됐다. 재판에서 전쟁 수행의 책임을 스스로 떠안았다.
events.description_en: He was indicted as a Class A war criminal before the International Military Tribunal for the Far East. In the proceedings he took responsibility for the conduct of the war onto himself.

events.title: 교수형에 처해지다
events.description: 극동국제군사재판에서 사형을 선고받고 스가모 형무소에서 교수형에 처해졌다.
events.description_en: Sentenced to death by the Tokyo tribunal, he was hanged at Sugamo Prison.
